intent: A barbershop charging for a haircut
reason: A haircut is a hairdresser service, and the live code for beauty salons and hairdressers ('all kinds of services') names hairdressers outright, so it is the most precise. The other live code, 'Услуги салонов красоты', means the same thing and is also acceptable; the separate haircut and hairdresser codes that used to exist are switched off.

alternatives_considered.name: Услуги косметолога по лечению и проведению процедур
alternatives_considered.why_not: Medical cosmetology procedures by a licensed clinic, not a haircut.

alternatives_considered.name: Персональные услуги, нигде не поименованные
alternatives_considered.why_not: Catch-all for personal services that have no code of their own; hairdressing has one.

alternatives_considered.name: Бытовые услуги прочие
alternatives_considered.why_not: Catch-all 'other household services'; a specific salon code exists.

intent: A nail studio charging for a manicure
reason: Nail care is a beauty-salon service, so both live salon codes fit; the 'beauty salons and hairdressers (all kinds of services)' code is the most precise because it explicitly covers every salon service. The dedicated manicure and pedicure codes are switched off, so neither can go on a receipt.

alternatives_considered.name: Услуги косметолога по лечению и проведению процедур
alternatives_considered.why_not: Medical cosmetology by a licensed clinic, not a salon manicure.

alternatives_considered.name: Услуги дерматолога по лечению и проведению процедур
alternatives_considered.why_not: Medical treatment of skin or nail disease, not cosmetic nail care.

alternatives_considered.name: Бытовые услуги прочие
alternatives_considered.why_not: Catch-all 'other household services'; the salon codes fit.

intent: A phone repair stall charging for a screen replacement
reason: The catalog has a position just for repairing and servicing mobile devices, so that is the code. The replacement screen, if billed as its own line, is a goods line; an older mobile-repair code with almost the same name is switched off.

alternatives_considered.name: Услуги по ремонту и техническому обслуживанию бытовых приборов, аппаратуры, электроники и техники (кроме систем кондиционерования, онлайн ККМ)
alternatives_considered.why_not: Broader household appliances and electronics repair; the catalog carved mobile devices out into their own position.

alternatives_considered.name: Услуги по ремонту и техническому обслуживанию компьютеров, установке программных продуктов (все виды услуг)
alternatives_considered.why_not: Repair of computers and installing software, not phones.

alternatives_considered.name: Регистрация IMEI кодов мобильных устройств.
alternatives_considered.why_not: Registering a phone's IMEI is a different service.

intent: A language centre selling a monthly English course
reason: The catalog has no separate language-course code; the courses-and-tutoring code covers courses 'in all subjects', English included. An older 'study course' code is switched off.

alternatives_considered.name: Прочие образовательные услуги
alternatives_considered.why_not: Catch-all 'other educational services'; the courses code fits exactly.

alternatives_considered.name: Образовательные услуги в сфере информационно-коммуникационных технологий (в том числе через глобальной информационной сети интернет)
alternatives_considered.why_not: Only for IT and digital-skills courses.

alternatives_considered.name: Услуги по организации кружков, мастер-классов, воркшопов
alternatives_considered.why_not: Hobby clubs, master classes and one-off workshops, not a structured course.

alternatives_considered.name: Услуги по языковым переводам (письменные, устные) и редакционным работам (услуги по работе с текстом, стенографии)
alternatives_considered.why_not: Translating texts or speech, not teaching a language.

alternatives_considered.name: Услуги профессионального образования
alternatives_considered.why_not: Formal vocational education (colleges, technical schools), not a language course.

intent: A private tutor invoicing maths lessons
reason: The courses code explicitly includes individual tutoring in any subject, so it fits a maths tutor exactly.

alternatives_considered.name: Услуги негосударственного школьного образования
alternatives_considered.why_not: For a licensed school teaching the school curriculum, not private lessons.

alternatives_considered.name: Прочие образовательные услуги
alternatives_considered.why_not: Catch-all 'other educational services'; tutoring is named in the courses code.

alternatives_considered.name: Образовательные услуги в сфере информационно-коммуникационных технологий (в том числе через глобальной информационной сети интернет)
alternatives_considered.why_not: Only for IT and digital-skills teaching.

intent: A landlord invoicing monthly office rent
reason: An office unit is non-residential premises, so 'rent of residential and non-residential premises' is the precise code. If the landlord leases out a whole office building, 'rent of buildings and structures' is also correct.

alternatives_considered.name: Услуги по кратковременной аренде рабочих мест (в т.ч. персонал), в т.ч. воркспейсы, коворкинг центры и аналогичные места
alternatives_considered.why_not: Short-term rent of desks or workplaces in a coworking space, not a leased office.

alternatives_considered.name: Услуги по субаренде помещений
alternatives_considered.why_not: Only if the merchant is a tenant sub-letting the office, not the landlord.

alternatives_considered.name: Плата за содержание нежилого помещения (услуги ТСЧЖ за содержание общего нежилого имущества)
alternatives_considered.why_not: Owners' association fee for upkeep of non-residential premises, not rent.

alternatives_considered.name: Услуги по аренде земельного участка (территории)
alternatives_considered.why_not: Land plots only.

intent: A business renting out apartments by the night
reason: Nightly stays are short-term accommodation, and the catalog's code for temporary housing in 'other short-stay places' (it lists guest houses and hostels) fits best; treating it as ordinary residential rent is also defensible. Which one the Tax Committee expects isn't settled, and it matters because the tourist levy is charged on accommodation, not on rent.

alternatives_considered.name: Гостиничные услуги (за проживание)
alternatives_considered.why_not: Only for a hotel or a registered aparthotel.

alternatives_considered.name: Услуги по субаренде помещений
alternatives_considered.why_not: Only under the rent reading, and only if the business sub-lets flats it rents itself.

alternatives_considered.name: Сборы, Туристский (гостиничный) сбор
alternatives_considered.why_not: The tourist levy is its own receipt line, not the charge for the stay.

intent: A taxi company issuing a fiscal receipt for a ride
reason: A taxi ride is 'carriage of passengers by car (non-fixed-route taxi)'. A marshrutka on a fixed route has its own code, and a ride-hailing app's own fee for arranging the trip is a separate software service.

alternatives_considered.name: Услуга по перевозке пассажиров на общественном транспорте, на маршрутке (линейное такси)
alternatives_considered.why_not: Fixed-route shared taxi (marshrutka), not a taxi ride.

alternatives_considered.name: Услуги по содействию в организации перевозки пассажиров, багажа и (или) доставки отправлений с использованием программного обеспечения
alternatives_considered.why_not: What a ride-hailing app charges for arranging the trip, not the ride itself.

alternatives_considered.name: Трансферные услуги
alternatives_considered.why_not: Pre-booked transfer service; an ordinary taxi ride has its own code.

alternatives_considered.name: Услуги по аренде транспортных средств
alternatives_considered.why_not: Renting out the vehicle, not carrying the passenger.

intent: A trucking company billing a client for moving goods within Uzbekistan
reason: Carrying goods by truck inside the country is road freight 'by local routes'; the same sub-position's root code is also acceptable. The cross-border attributes are for international legs, and an older code named literally for 'грузоперевозки' is switched off.

alternatives_considered.name: Услуги по перевозке грузов автомобильным транспортом, в пункте за пределами территории государства
alternatives_considered.why_not: International leg (point outside the country); wrong for a domestic haul.

alternatives_considered.name: Транспортно-логистические услуги, Оказание внутренних транспортных перевозок
alternatives_considered.why_not: For a logistics operator selling an organised transport service, not a carrier hauling with its own trucks.

alternatives_considered.name: Транспортно-экспедиторская услуга
alternatives_considered.why_not: Freight forwarding: arranging someone else's carriage, not carrying the goods.

alternatives_considered.name: Служба доставки товаров
alternatives_considered.why_not: Delivering purchases to customers, not freight haulage.

intent: A courier company charging for parcel delivery
reason: 'Курьерская услуга' is the exact code for a courier delivering parcels. 'Служба доставки товаров' also describes delivering goods and is acceptable, but it is less precise for a courier firm.

alternatives_considered.name: Почтовая услуга
alternatives_considered.why_not: Service of a postal operator, not a courier.

alternatives_considered.name: Служба доставки еды
alternatives_considered.why_not: Food delivery.

alternatives_considered.name: Почтовые (курьерские) отправления
alternatives_considered.why_not: A goods code for the parcel itself, not the delivery service.

alternatives_considered.name: Услуги по содействию в организации перевозки пассажиров, багажа и (или) доставки отправлений с использованием программного обеспечения
alternatives_considered.why_not: A delivery app's fee for arranging the delivery, not the delivery.

intent: A cleaning company charging for an apartment clean
reason: Cleaning any premises, a flat included, is 'cleaning of buildings, premises and territories (all kinds of services)'. 'Housekeeping services' is defensible when the cleaning is part of ongoing home help, but it is less precise for a cleaning company.

alternatives_considered.name: Услуги комплексные по обслуживанию и эксплуатации зданий, сооружений, помещений и территорий (объектов)
alternatives_considered.why_not: Full building maintenance and operation contracts, not a one-off clean.

alternatives_considered.name: Чистка ковров и ковровых изделий
alternatives_considered.why_not: Carpet cleaning only.

alternatives_considered.name: Услуги по дезинфекции, дезинсекции и дератизации
alternatives_considered.why_not: Disinfection and pest control.

alternatives_considered.name: Услуги по проверке, обследованиям, изучениям и чистке (по всем направлениям)
alternatives_considered.why_not: Catch-all 'checks, inspections and cleaning'; a specific cleaning code exists.

intent: A dry cleaner charging for cleaning a coat
reason: Dry cleaning has its own code, 'Химическая чистка (химчистка)'. Washing and ironing, carpet cleaning and dyeing are separate codes, and an older dry-cleaning-and-laundry code is switched off.

alternatives_considered.name: Услуги прачечных и глажки
alternatives_considered.why_not: Washing and ironing, not dry cleaning.

alternatives_considered.name: Чистка ковров и ковровых изделий
alternatives_considered.why_not: Carpets only.

alternatives_considered.name: Крашение материалов для бытовых нужд (все виды услуг)
alternatives_considered.why_not: Dyeing fabrics.

intent: A gym selling a monthly membership
reason: A fitness membership fits 'fitness and wellness centre services (all kinds)', which also matches the word 'фитнес'. 'Тренажерный зал' and the newer 'Услуги спортивно-тренировочных залов' also describe a gym (in Uzbek they are named almost identically), so both are acceptable; the newer one carries no benefit marker. The code for access to sports facilities explicitly excludes gyms.

alternatives_considered.name: Услуги по доступу (в т.ч. разовый доступ) и аренде закрытых и открытых спортивных объектов и помещений (спортивные арены, залы, катки, площадки и помещения для игры в гольф, настольный теннис и др) - кроме бассейнов, тренажерных залов, теннисных кортов и футбольных полей
alternatives_considered.why_not: Access to and rent of sports facilities; explicitly excludes gyms, pools, tennis courts and football fields.

alternatives_considered.name: Услуги фитнес-центров и оздоровительных центров (все виды услуг), оказываемые бюджетными организациями
alternatives_considered.why_not: Variant for budget-funded organisations only.

alternatives_considered.name: Услуги спортивных секций по видам спорта (кроме гимнастики и легкой атлетики)
alternatives_considered.why_not: Coached sports-section training, not gym access.

alternatives_considered.name: Услуги бассейна
alternatives_considered.why_not: Swimming pool only.

intent: A private dental clinic adding its dental services: treatment, and consultations billed on their own
reason: Treatment goes under 'dentist services for treatment and procedures'; a consultation billed on its own is 'Консультация стоматолога'. The original intent said 'billing a treatment', under which the consultation code would be wrong, so the intent now covers both; the clinic needs a medical licence either way, and the long list of old per-procedure dental codes is switched off.

alternatives_considered.name: Услуги пародонтолога по лечению и проведению процедур
alternatives_considered.why_not: Only for periodontist treatment.

alternatives_considered.name: Услуги зубных техников, услуги изготовления зубных кап (элайнеров) по индивидуальным заказам
alternatives_considered.why_not: Dental lab work (crowns, aligners made to order), not the clinic's treatment.

alternatives_considered.name: Комплексные услуги врачей-специалистов по лечению и проведению процедур
alternatives_considered.why_not: Bundled multi-specialist treatment; dentistry has its own code.

alternatives_considered.name: Услуги частных оздоровительных и медицинских учреждений, Услуги прочих частных оздоровительных и медицинских учреждений
alternatives_considered.why_not: Sanatorium and rehabilitation position, not a dental clinic.

intent: A massage studio adding massage to its price list (whether it holds a medical licence is unknown)
reason: No live code names non-medical massage: the old massage codes are switched off, and the only code with the word is 'medical massage', which only a licensed medical provider may use. A beauty or relaxation studio would use a beauty-salon code (the usual choice) or the fitness-and-wellness-centre code; the Tax Committee hasn't said which it expects, and an exact code can be requested on tasnif.soliq.uz.

alternatives_considered.name: Услуги бань, душевых, саун (все виды услуг)
alternatives_considered.why_not: Only when the massage is sold by a bath or sauna.

alternatives_considered.name: Персональные услуги, нигде не поименованные
alternatives_considered.why_not: Catch-all; salon and wellness codes already fit.

alternatives_considered.name: Услуги частных оздоровительных и медицинских учреждений, Услуги прочих частных оздоровительных и медицинских учреждений
alternatives_considered.why_not: Sanatoria and private medical institutions, not a massage studio.

alternatives_considered.name: Реабилитационные услуги, Физиотерапия
alternatives_considered.why_not: Medical physiotherapy, licensed providers only.

intent: A photographer charging for a photo shoot
reason: 'Фото и видео услуги (все виды услуг)' covers a photo shoot and is the only live photography code; an older code with the same name is switched off.

alternatives_considered.name: Услуги по производству (постпроизводственного этапа) кино и видеофильмов
alternatives_considered.why_not: Producing films and videos for release, not a photo shoot.

alternatives_considered.name: Услуги по изданию прочих печатных материалов (календари, открытки, фотографии) на типографиях
alternatives_considered.why_not: Printing photos, calendars and postcards at a print shop.

alternatives_considered.name: Услуги художников, писателей, композиторов, скульптуров, мультипликаторов, граверов и других художников (авторов)
alternatives_considered.why_not: Artists and authors creating works.

intent: A web studio invoicing a website build
reason: A website is software, and the software design and development code applies 'for any platform', so it fits a full build best. The multimedia/web/graphics code is really about design (its Uzbek name reads as web design), so it suits design-only jobs; the old 'Разработка сайтов' code is switched off.

alternatives_considered.name: Прочие услуги в сфере информационных технологий
alternatives_considered.why_not: Catch-all for IT services with no code of their own.

alternatives_considered.name: Услуги в сфере цифровых информационных технологий
alternatives_considered.why_not: Sits under electronic document management; too vague for a website.

alternatives_considered.name: Услуги графического дизайна по разработке корпоративного стиля, рекламного дизайна и других направлений графики
alternatives_considered.why_not: Brand identity and advertising design, not a website.

alternatives_considered.name: Услуги хостинга, а также услуги аренды серверов
alternatives_considered.why_not: Hosting and server rent, billed on its own line if at all.

alternatives_considered.name: Информационные и управленческие системы, услуги технической поддержки, улучшения, модификации, поддержки и интеграции для работы программного обеспечения
alternatives_considered.why_not: Support, modification and integration of existing software, for work after launch.

intent: A SaaS company invoicing a monthly subscription
reason: SaaS sells access to software the provider runs, which is exactly 'providing third parties access to software (a database)'. If the contract is written as a licence to use the software, the right-of-use and licence code is correct instead; the old 'rented application software' code is switched off.

alternatives_considered.name: Программные продукты
alternatives_considered.why_not: A goods code for a software product sold as a copy, not a subscription service.

alternatives_considered.name: Услуга по предоставлению доступа к мультимедийному контенту (музыке, фильмам, сериалам), другим цифровым развлечениям, а также к маркетинговым предложениям через программное обеспечение
alternatives_considered.why_not: Access to music, films and other entertainment content.

alternatives_considered.name: Услуги хостинга, а также услуги аренды серверов
alternatives_considered.why_not: Hosting and server rent (infrastructure), not an application.

alternatives_considered.name: Услуги в сфере цифровых информационных технологий
alternatives_considered.why_not: Sits under electronic document management; too vague for a SaaS product.

alternatives_considered.name: Информационные и управленческие системы, услуги технической поддержки, улучшения, модификации, поддержки и интеграции для работы программного обеспечения
alternatives_considered.why_not: Technical support and modification of software, not access to it.

intent: A wedding agency invoicing the organisation of a wedding
reason: The only wedding code is 'complex services for holding weddings, banquets and other events', and its Uzbek name says 'o’tkazish (tashkil etish)', holding and organising. It sits among catering and banquet-hall services, but the general events code explicitly excludes weddings, so that one can never be used.

alternatives_considered.name: Услуги по организации конференций, выставок, тренингов, мероприятий (кроме свадебных мероприятий)
alternatives_considered.why_not: Conferences, exhibitions, trainings and events, explicitly 'except weddings'.

alternatives_considered.name: Ритуальные и обрядовые услуги (все виды услуг)
alternatives_considered.why_not: Ritual and rite services with their own benefit marker; the catalog sends weddings to the wedding code instead.

alternatives_considered.name: Услуга ведущего мероприятий в заведениях общественного питания
alternatives_considered.why_not: Only the event host's fee, if billed as its own line.

alternatives_considered.name: Услуга оформления зала/территории в заведениях общественного питания (банкетных залах)
alternatives_considered.why_not: Only hall decoration, if billed as its own line.

alternatives_considered.name: Услуги зрелищно-развлекательные и по организации отдыха и развлечений прочие
alternatives_considered.why_not: Catch-all entertainment; weddings have their own code.

intent: An agency invoicing online advertising for a client
reason: Running online ads for a client is an advertising service; the advertising code excludes only outdoor placement, so internet ads fit. The SMM code fits social-media campaigns; the old codes named for internet advertising and social-media work are switched off.

alternatives_considered.name: Услуги по размещению рекламы и объявлений в программном обеспечении, предоставляемые клиентом
alternatives_considered.why_not: For the owner of an app or site selling ad space inside its own software.

alternatives_considered.name: Маркетинговые услуги
alternatives_considered.why_not: Broader marketing (research, strategy); advertising has its own code.

alternatives_considered.name: Консультационные услуги маркетинговые и рекламные
alternatives_considered.why_not: Advice on marketing and advertising, not running the ads.

alternatives_considered.name: Услуги журналистов, блогеров
alternatives_considered.why_not: A journalist's or blogger's own services.

alternatives_considered.name: Услуги размещения рекламной продукции (рекламных баннеров, роликов и др.) на объектах наружной рекламы
alternatives_considered.why_not: Outdoor billboards and screens.

intent: An outsourced bookkeeper invoicing monthly accounting
reason: Keeping a client's books is 'Бухгалтерские услуги' ('Buxgalteriya xizmatlari' in Uzbek). Advice on accounting, tax advice and audits have separate codes.

alternatives_considered.name: Консультационные услуги по вопросам ведения бухгалтерского и управленческого учета
alternatives_considered.why_not: Advice on accounting, not keeping the books.

alternatives_considered.name: Консультационные услуги по вопросам налогообложения
alternatives_considered.why_not: Tax advice.

alternatives_considered.name: Услуги проведения аудита предприятия (аудиторские услуги) и проведения инвентаризации ТМЦ
alternatives_considered.why_not: Audits and stock counts.

intent: A lawyer invoicing a legal consultation (whether they are a licensed advocate is unknown)
reason: 'Юридические консультации' is the literal code and right for a lawyer or law firm. A licensed advocate may instead bill under 'advocate services (all kinds)', which covers consultations and carries its own benefit marker, and the Tax Committee may expect that from advocates. The general legal-services code explicitly excludes consultations, so it is never acceptable.

alternatives_considered.name: Юридические услуги (все виды, кроме консультаций, адвокатских и нотариальных услуг)
alternatives_considered.why_not: Explicitly excludes consultations, advocate and notary services.

alternatives_considered.name: Прочие услуги в области права и юриспруденции
alternatives_considered.why_not: Catch-all; consultations have their own code.

alternatives_considered.name: Нотариальные услуги
alternatives_considered.why_not: Notary services only.

alternatives_considered.name: Консультационные услуги по вопросам налогообложения
alternatives_considered.why_not: Tax advice only.

intent: A car wash issuing a receipt
reason: 'Cleaning and washing of motor vehicles (car wash)' is the exact code; its Uzbek name ends in 'avtomoyka xizmati'. Several older car-wash codes with near-identical names are switched off.

alternatives_considered.name: Услуги по диагностике, ремонту и техническому обслуживанию легковых автомобилей и мотоциклов (все виды услуг)
alternatives_considered.why_not: Car repair and maintenance; washing has its own code.

alternatives_considered.name: Автомастерские услуги прочие
alternatives_considered.why_not: Other car-workshop services; washing has its own code.

alternatives_considered.name: Услуги по проверке, обследованиям, изучениям и чистке (по всем направлениям)
alternatives_considered.why_not: Catch-all checks and cleaning.

intent: A tyre shop charging a car owner for tyre fitting and balancing
reason: The dedicated tyre-fitting, balancing and wheel-alignment codes are all switched off, so no live code names this work. Tyre work is car maintenance, which the passenger-car repair and maintenance code covers as 'all kinds of services'; 'other car-workshop services' is the defensible alternative, truck tyres go under the truck code, and an exact code can be requested on tasnif.soliq.uz.

intent: A private kindergarten charging parents monthly fees
reason: A private kindergarten with a preschool-education licence uses 'non-state preschool education'; the generic preschool code describes the same service but carries a different benefit marker, so it is second choice. A private daycare without that licence can't bill education, and its lawful code is childcare ('присмотр и уход за детьми'), so the licence decides.
